# stalwart_mta_queue_quota (Data Source)

Defines a quota rule for message queues.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Short description for the quota
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether to enable this quota
- `key` (Set of String) Optional list of context variables that determine where this quota should be applied
- `match` (Attributes) Enable the imposition of concurrency and rate limits only when a specific condition is met (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `messages` (Number) Maximum number of messages in the queue that this quota will allow
- `size` (Number) Maximum total size of messages in the queue that this quota will allow

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Read-Only:

- `else` (String) Else condition
- `match` (Attributes List) List of conditions and their corresponding results (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match--match))

<a id="nestedatt--match--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match.match`

Read-Only:

- `if` (String) If condition
- `then` (String) Then clause
